description: Probe catalog for China Telecom Tianyi Cloud Drive.

probe_items.goal: Capture Browser ID and cookie session required by current telecom provider requests.
notes: Current provider primarily depends on Browser ID plus cookies.

probe_items.goal: Verify listFiles.action can enumerate the configured root folder.
Verify getUserInfoForPortal.action and recover capacity metrics.
notes: Used by current telecom health path.

probe_items.goal: Verify a listed telecom file can be resolved and downloaded.
notes: Download is already working in provider-telecom.

probe_items.goal: Discover stable directory creation, delete, rename, copy, move, and upload paths for telecom.
notes: Telecom upload and metadata object actions are implemented in Rust provider tests, but the live request-shape catalog is still partial.
Current step is configuration-first: browser-flow upload probes and request-shape capture should confirm drift before broadening native implementation.

As of 2026-05-21, a live personal-space upload capture on https://cloud.189.cn/web/main/file/folder/-11 confirmed a multipart upload chain built around getMultiUploadUrls, OSS-style PUT part uploads, checkTransSecond, and commitMultiUploadFile.
Observed object-store part uploads used 10 MiB chunks against bjoss.ctyunxs.cn with query parameters partNumber and uploadId.
Observed business requests carried Telecom-specific signing headers such as sessionkey, signature, x-request-date, x-request-id, encryptiontext, and pkid.
Observed object-store PUT requests carried authorization, content-md5, x-amz-date, x-amz-limit, and content-type.
The current upload probe should be re-run with a brand-new random filename because the captured sample showed 已秒传 / 覆盖上传 hints and may have skipped or compressed the earliest init branch.

Before adding new native implementation paths, extend config/provider-capabilities/telecom-native.json with confirmed request templates so page drift remains a catalog update rather than a Rust rewrite.
